mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rider (user_id, name, phone, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{name}, #{phone}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, name, phone, status, create_time FROM rider WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, user_id, name, phone, status, create_time FROM rider WHERE user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1

SELECT r.id, r.user_id, u.username, r.name, r.phone, r.status, r.create_time FROM rider r JOIN `user` u ON u.id = r.user_id
AND (r.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR r.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY r.status DESC, r.create_time DESC
